title: Abnormal cases on the network side

entities.name: Security mode control procedure
entities.description: Procedure for establishing security between UE and network.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE COMMAND
entities.description: Message sent by network to initiate security mode control procedure.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE COMPLETE
entities.description: Message sent by UE to complete security mode control procedure.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by UE to reject security mode control procedure.

entities.name: Timer T3560
entities.description: Timer used for retransmission of SECURITY MODE COMMAND message.

entities.name: Lower layer failure
entities.description: Condition where lower layer fails before SECURITY MODE COMPLETE or SECURITY MODE REJECT is received.

entities.name: Timer T3560 expiry
entities.description: Condition when timer T3560 expires, triggering retransmission or procedure abortion.

entities.name: Procedure collision
entities.description: Condition where security mode control procedure collides with other procedures.

entities.name: Handover non-delivery
entities.description: Condition where NAS PDU cannot be delivered due to handover.

entities.name: Procedure abortion
entities.description: Network behavior of aborting security mode control procedure.

entities.name: Message retransmission
entities.description: Network behavior of retransmitting SECURITY MODE COMMAND message.

relations.description: Lower layer failure before SECURITY MODE COMPLETE/REJECT causes procedure abortion.
First four T3560 expiries trigger SECURITY MODE COMMAND retransmission.
Fifth T3560 expiry causes procedure abortion.
Security mode control procedure starts timer T3560.
Security mode control procedure resets timer T3560 on retransmission.
Collision with registration/service/de-registration procedures causes security mode control abortion.
Handover non-delivery of SECURITY MODE COMMAND triggers retransmission after successful handover.
Security mode control procedure includes sending SECURITY MODE COMMAND message.
